correctness.rationale: Sion minimax applied to pairs of trace-one positive densities turns hard expectation box constraints into the support-function penalty, yielding the spectral spread. At an extreme feasible mixed-pair (r,s), supported Hermitian perturbations have dimension r²+s² and at most 2 trace plus 2 active independent equations, so r²+s²≤4 and necessarily r=s=1. Every maximum has a pure extreme maximizer; finite-dimensional linear-image distance gives dual attainment. On qubit Bloch-ball differences the constrained profile is e+sqrt(4−e²) until e=√2 then 2√2. Zero tolerances are covered mathematically but not claimed novel.
